current_policy_observed_2026_08_14: Inactive blogs may be archived and become no longer publicly accessible/viewable.
The platform guide states that removed blogs are not deleted but archived.
Blog administrators may request unarchiving through the platform support process.
Blog administrators can export posts/pages as WordPress XML; media files require separate handling.
institutional_archive_policy_evidence.interpretation: The platform policy creates a lawful recovery route worth testing; it does not prove that the specific Linear A blog or its media files remain recoverable.

recovery_targets_in_priority_order.scientific_value: Recover links, file names, project descriptions, corpus version provenance, and possibly attachment references without guessing.

platform_route.restriction: Unarchive requests normally require an authorized blog administrator/current NTU route; JANUS does not claim authority to request administrative restoration on someone else's behalf.

rules: Preserve original exported/archive bytes before opening, converting or normalizing.
Hash site export and every recovered attachment separately with SHA-256 and byte length.
Record whether each attachment is original, platform-exported, archive-replayed, or later author-supplied.
Do not infer paper-exact 2024 identity solely from filename or project-lineage similarity.
Do not use selected published language matches to choose among recovered files or preprocessing variants.
